summary: The prepared source already contains MiMo-V2.5 Pro-specific fused-QKV checkpoint loading, TP compatibility validation, and block-scale de-interleave/requantization. Added focused regression coverage and verified the transformation numerically. No product-code change was justified without the reported private W8A8 checkpoint and Ascend topology.

tests.what_was_measured: Six CPU cases covering compatible TP shard merging, incompatible TP rejection, QKV de-interleave plus FP8 scale requantization, and fused-QKV config boundaries; 6 passed.
Repository formatting, static checks, and registered-test CI metadata for the new regression.

tests.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 SGLANG_ENABLE_TP_MEMORY_INBALANCE_CHECK=0 /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-613914db80e1/venv/bin/python < gfx950 fused-QKV numerical fixture
tests.what_was_measured: On AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950, de-interleave/requantization recovered [1,2,5.1428576,6.0000005,3,7,4,8] against [1,2,5,6,3,7,4,8], max absolute FP8 rounding error 0.1428576.

remaining_limitations: No Ascend 910B device or CANN runtime was available; the NPU kernel path was not executed.
The private /home/weights/MiMo-V2.5-Pro-W8A8 checkpoint was unavailable, so its exact tensor metadata and semantic accuracy could not be checked.
Only one gfx950 GPU was assigned; the reported 2-node TP32/DP4 topology was not reproduced.
The GPU fixture validates tensor layout arithmetic only and is not a substitute for model accuracy or distributed serving validation.
